changes.english_version: Official text is French only (SGDSN page and press release); no English text of the page itself is stored, so recorded as none found. The SGDSN also publishes an English roadmap PDF (document-1.pdf), a different document.

Nothing says it was closed or replaced, so Published (non-binding, current) stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: AI safety institute mandate; clearly in scope.
